objective: Certificar Gate12J en READ_ONLY corrigiendo exclusivamente la serializacion de columnas uniqueidentifier detectada en R2. Mantener el mismo objetivo funcional: definir el flujo canonico Socio Cava -> Gobierno_Persona -> Gobierno_PersonaVinculo -> Cliente_Catalogo cuando corresponda, sin matching automatico por nombre/email/telefono, preservando SocioID, Botellas/Cargos/Movimientos y compatibilidad legacy ClienteCRMID. No modificar codigo, SQL, RBAC, secrets ni Produccion. No avanzar a 12K.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: current_cava_socios
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,NombreCompleto,Email,Telefono,CONVERT(varchar(36),ClienteCRMID) AS ClienteCRMID,PersonaID,Estatus,Activo FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios ORDER BY EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,SocioID;

queries.name: persona_link_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: persona_population
queries.sql: SELECT PersonaID,CONVERT(varchar(36),PublicUUID) AS PublicUUID,Nombre,ApellidoPaterno,ApellidoMaterno,RFC,CURP,Activo FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona ORDER BY PersonaID;

queries.name: persona_vinculos
queries.sql: SELECT VinculoID,PersonaID,UsuarioID,ClienteID,ProveedorID,ContactoClienteID,ContactoProveedorID,EsPrincipal,Activo,FechaAlta,UsuarioAltaID FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo ORDER BY VinculoID;

queries.name: cliente_catalogo_actual
queries.sql: SELECT ClienteID,CodigoCliente,RFC,CURP,RazonSocial,NombreComercial,TipoPersona,EmailPrincipal,TelefonoPrincipal,Activo,CONVERT(varchar(36),PublicUUID) AS PublicUUID FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo ORDER BY ClienteID;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_unique_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo') AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: persona_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT kc.name AS constraint_name,kc.type_desc FROM sys.key_constraints kc WHERE kc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') UNION ALL SELECT fk.name,'FOREIGN_KEY' FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') ORDER BY constraint_name;

queries.name: cava_persona_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';
